title: Ordering coffee
description: Ordering at the counter, choosing takeaway, and paying.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning! What can I get you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: A large coffee with milk, please.
lines.note: poproszę = the polite way to order: 'I'll have…'

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: To go, please. How much do I pay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Czternaście złotych. Płaci pan kartą czy gotówką?
lines.english: Fourteen zloty. Are you paying by card or cash?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: By card. Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here you are. Have a nice day!
lines.note: proszę bardzo = 'here you are' when handing something over
